name: Highlands and South-Central Coast
climate: Da Lat stays cool year-round. The beaches are calmer in the drier months, which differ by town.
days: 3 to 5 days if you pair Da Lat with one beach.
summary: Cool hills and warm beaches that now sometimes share a province. Da Lat, Nha Trang, and Mui Ne are separate trips even when the map groups them.
body: After the 2025 provincial mergers, some inland highlands and beach towns sit inside the same province. Plan them as different climates. Da Lat is a cool hill station. Nha Trang and Mui Ne are beach towns with their own sea seasons.
Most visitors fly into Da Lat or Nha Trang, or take a sleeper from Ho Chi Minh City. Treat this corridor as a side trip from the south, not as a same-day hop between the hills and the sand.
seoTitle: Da Lat, Nha Trang, and Mui Ne
seoDescription: How the central highlands and the south-central beaches differ, and how many days to allow.
